current.text: He is projected as Cleveland's backup point guard to start the season. Malik Thomas may also get a look in that role.
Cleveland's second unit has no clear point guard. Schroder, Ellis and Strus are gone, and the projected bench is Tyson, Merrill, Bryant, Tomlin and Porter.
This is his fourth NBA season.
Danny calls this season now or never for him to win a rotation spot.
Cleveland has the most back-to-backs in the league.
With our March 28 end, Cleveland plays 4, 3 and 2 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21. The finals week is a two-game week.

durable.text: He is a strong defender. The expert calls him one of the best shot-blocking and steal-getting guards in the NBA and compares him to Derrick White.
He averaged a block per game in 21 minutes over the final six games of last season.
The expert thinks he can give 1.3 combined steals and blocks per game.
He is a solid rebounder and passer for a guard.
He is not a scorer, and his offense and shooting are iffy.
His projected points are far below the top 250 pool.
36% from three is a realistic level for him.
He is not a great free throw shooter.

note: Yahoo ranks him 299th and gives him a value of 0 USD. ESPN has no price for him. That puts him far outside the 144 players our league drafts, so do not draft him. The expert sees a Derrick White-type steals and blocks guard (0.9 steals and 0.6 blocks in 17.9 minutes last season), but Yahoo projects only 0.5 steals and 0.4 blocks, and his points are a big weakness. Early in the season, check whether he holds the backup point guard minutes ahead of Malik Thomas. If he gets about 20 minutes, he becomes a stocks pickup for teams that can absorb low points.
